sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.0099 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 506
Ipc & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Sujauli, District Bahraich.

entities.text: D.P. Act, P.S. Sujauli, District Bahraich
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 17.02.2024 and thereafter, the matrimonial family used to harass her and on 19.06.2024, the entire matrimonial family had killed her and had thrown her in the canal.
The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem drowning.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that family members of the deceased were present at the time of inquest as well as at the time of funeral and no apprehension was expressed.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the postmortem report does not indicate any injury and the cause of death is ante mortem drowning, prima-facie, the material to suggest that the applicant had subjected the victim to mental or physical harassment soon before her death in relation to demand of dowry is apparently missing, as such, the applicant who has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Sumita @ Chukkaiya Devi be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
